title: CPF Module Schema: Subscription module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-subscription'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

billing_account_name.description: (Required) The Azure Billing Scope ID. Can be a Microsoft Customer Account Billing Scope ID, a Microsoft Partner Account Billing Scope ID or an Enrollment Billing Scope ID.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 71 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

workload.description: (Optional) Subscription type. More information: [Enterprise Dev/Test subscription](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/offers/ms-azr-0148p/). • Value of `workload` must be one of: `[Production,DevTest]`.

id.description: The resource ID of the Alias.

subscription_name.description: The Name of the Subscription. This is the Display Name in the portal.

tenant_id.description: The ID of the Tenant to which the subscription belongs.

workload.description: The workload type of the Subscription.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Subscription' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
